title: utPLSQL Announcements
description: Releases and news from the utPLSQL project

items.title: utPLSQL-cli and utPLSQL-maven-plugin v3.2.1 released
items.content_html: Both utPLSQL-cli and utPLSQL-maven-plugin v3.2.1 are now available, adding support for Oracle Wallet (Secure External Password Store) connections.

items.title: Incorporation of utPLSQL Development Labs Ltd
items.content_html: For many years, utPLSQL has been built and maintained through the contributions of dedicated and passionate engineers from the community.

items.title: Next chapter for utPLSQL
items.content_html: utPLSQL v3 has come a long way since it was first released in 2017. It has already been over 10 years since the first discussions about starting the project began. However…

items.title: utPLSQL v3.2.3 released
items.content_html: Fix issue with UT_TAP_REPORTER on Oracle 23.26 · Fixed support for camelCase in context --%name annotation · utPLSQL can be installed in editioned schema · +4 more

items.title: utPLSQL for SQL Developer v2.0.0 and v2.0.1
items.content_html: This is a maintenance release all dependencies and changes by @PhilippSalvisberg

items.title: Website navigation improvements
items.content_html: We've been busy improving the utPLSQL website experience over the past couple of days.

items.title: utPLSQL v3.2.2 released
items.content_html: Filtering by tags fixed for schemas containing suite-paths and contexts · Fixed issue with reporter failing to initialize · +2 more

items.title: utPLSQL v3.2.01 released
items.content_html: Dropped support for Oracle Database versions older than 19c · Add TAP reporter · Added duplicate detection on cursor comparison using join_by · +4 more

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.14 released
items.content_html: Added support for and and or operators when running tests by tags · Allow for test runs over 4 hours · Framework performance improvements · +10 more

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.13 released
items.content_html: Add ability to run tests by part of a name · Added documentation section on creating a custom reporter · +8 more

items.title: New website design
items.content_html: Today is #JoelKallmanDay.

items.title: utPLSQL-cli v3.1.9 released
items.content_html: Bugfix/Locale-Info and Nullpointer · Feature/cleanup maven jdbc · Support a_coverage_schemes option of utPLSQL · Feature/GitHub actions · +2 more

items.title: utPLSQL-maven-plugin v3.1.10 released
items.content_html: Add new <ora-stuck-timeout> parameter

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.12 released
items.content_html: Added support for description in the --%disabled annotation · Added support for native JSON datatype on Oracle 21c · +8 more

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.11 released
items.content_html: utPLSQL can now be used to generate coverage reports for external tools · Enhanced UT_COVERAGE_COBERTURA_REPORTER to better support TFS and GitLab · +15 more

items.title: PL/SQL Developer plugin version 1.0.0 released
items.content_html: Happy new year! Thanks to Simon Martinelli utPLSQL v3+ is now integrated with PL/SQL Developer IDE

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.10 released
items.content_html: utPLSQL test runner is now validating arguments of --%throws annotations at runtime · Documented limitations of insignificant spaces comparison in compound data · +6 more

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.9 released
items.content_html: Added ability to define nested contexts within test suite · Added ability to exclude tests/suites by tags when invoking a test-run · +10 more

items.title: New Resources section
items.content_html: We just added a new section to our website: Resources.

items.title: utPLSQL v3.1.8 released
items.content_html: Added support for session context to provide test and suite information during test run · Added ability to invoke expectations without running framework · +9 more
